source_title: Wacky Evil Doll Horror Movie 'Jeffrey Dollmer' Trailer - WTF Is This?
source_excerpt:
"More lethal than Chucky, more wood than Pinocchio." Uncork'd Ent. has revealed an official trailer for a wacky indie horror comedy titled Jeffrey Dollmer , or I guess I should write it as Jeffery DOLLmer . This is getting a VOD release starting in November soon – if you need a laugh. WTF? Is this an SNL sketch? A wild new horror / slasher that puts a twisted spin on the killer doll genre by imagining the spirit of notorious serial killer Jeffrey Dahmer trapped inside a murderous doll. Packed with bloody mayhem, the new trailer offers a gruesome first look at the pint-sized killer. Follows models on a photo shoot who are stalked by a doll possessed by the spirit of serial killer Jeffrey Dahmer. Directed by Mark Savage, the film stars Charlie Trepany , Chey Crieger , Juliana Destefano , Adam Huss , Eva Hamilton , Mariah Justice , Scott Asmar , Jabarri Bush , Jane Xi , Tom Parnell , & Sean Michael Conway . Brian Joseph Mange plays Jeffrey Dahmer, while Jeffrey Reddick – creator of the Final Destination franchise – also makes a cameo appearance. As ridiculous as this whole thing is, it looks goofy & bonkers enough to actually be entertaining.
Here's the official trailer (+ poster) for Mark Savage's horror comedy Jeffrey Dollmer , from YouTube :
In 1991, Jeffrey Dahmer discovers a doll and performs a ritual in an attempt to transfer his spirit into it, but is captured before he can complete his sinister plans. For decades, the doll remains locked away in police evidence — until it is finally discarded and finds its way back into the world. In the present day, the doll’s spirit is accidentally summoned and quickly latches onto a young model who bears a resemblance to its former owner. When the model travels to a remote photo shoot, the possessed doll follows, turning the isolated set into a killing ground as it begins stalking fellow competitors and co-workers. Jeffrey Dollmer is directed by Australian genre filmmaker Mark Savage , director of the movies Marauders, Sensitive New Age Killer, Circus of the Dead, Bring Him Back Dead, Hell's Coming for You, Kill Craft, 12 to Midnight, Naked as Created: The Pastor Jim Moore Story previously. The screenplay is written by John Doolan & Jeff Miller; from a story by Jeff Miller. Produced by Jeff Miller. Uncork'd Entertainment debuts Savage's Jeffrey Dollmer horror movie direct-to-VOD starting November 3rd, 2026 this fall. Anyone want to watch this?
